beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows circulation: A public stream can widen technical access while ranking systems, language, bandwidth and platform ownership continue to govern attention.
beats.onScreen: Then: FHCM states that Paris Fashion Week Online launched in 2020 with Launchmetrics and support from LE DEFI; official calendars now have physical and digital dimensions.

beats.voice: FHCM states that Paris Fashion Week Online launched in 2020 with Launchmetrics and support from LE DEFI; official calendars now have physical and digital dimensions. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: The digital platform expanded official collection visibility, but a public stream does not establish open admission, neutral ranking or permanent preservation.
